week.desc: Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.
features: - Packages (package.json) and source files; skips nodemodules, build output, fixtures,
- Units: a folder of source files, or a file at a package's source root.
- Waves: a unit's imports come in earlier waves; import cycles are ported together.
- Bridge: napi-rs when the unit or anything it imports needs Node; wasm-bindgen for portable
- Readiness (how safe) and priority (safe and worth it: loops and string work, tests, size).
week.trDesc: 使用 Rust 逐一重写您的整个应用程序，并在每一步对照原始应用程序的记录行为进行检查。TypeScript、Python、C、Go、Ruby 和 Java 中的 CLI、HTTP 服务器和库。
week.trFeat:
- 包（package.json）和源文件；跳过 nodemodules、构建输出、夹具、
- 单元：源文件文件夹，或位于包的源根目录下的文件。
- 波次：一个单元的导入项在较早的波次中出现；导入循环一起移植。
- 桥接：当单元或其导入的任何内容需要 Node 时使用 napi-rs；使用 wasm-bindgen 实现可移植性 - 准备情况（安全性如何）和优先级（安全且值得：环和绳索工作、测试、尺寸）。

week.desc: Show the battery level of wireless mice, headsets, keyboards and controllers on the Windows 10/11 taskbar. Lightweight tray app, no vendor software needed. Supports Logitech, Razer, SteelSeries, Corsair, HyperX, Glorious, PS4/PS5 DualSense, Xbox and Bluetooth devices.
features: - Primary monitor only: the taskbar widget sits on the primary monitor's taskbar.
- Crowded taskbars: with a very full centered Windows 11 taskbar, the app buttons can reach the widget. On Windows 10 the task-button area is narrowed automatically.
- Sleeping devices: a device that is asleep may not answer. Its last value stays visible, dimmed. Logitech receivers drop sleeping devices from the link, so their last value is kept for 30 minutes.
- Keychron keyboards: they only report their battery over Bluetooth (shown via the Bluetooth support). Over the 2.4 GHz receiver the firmware does not expose it. Keychron mice are supported.
- Other devices: some 2.4 GHz devices use undocumented protocols and are not supported yet. See CONTRIBUTING.md for how to help add one.
week.trDesc: 在 Windows 10/11 任务栏上显示无线鼠标、耳机（含麦克风）、键盘和控制器的电量。轻量级托盘应用程序，无需供应商软件。支持罗技、雷蛇、赛睿、海盗船、HyperX、Glorious、PS4/PS5 DualSense、Xbox 和蓝牙设备。
week.trFeat:
- 仅主显示器：任务栏小部件位于主显示器的任务栏上。
- 拥挤的任务栏：如果 Windows 11 的居中任务栏非常拥挤，应用程序按钮可能会碰到小工具。在Windows 10上，任务按钮区域会自动缩小。
- 休眠设备：处于休眠状态的设备可能不会响应。其最后一个值仍会显示，但呈灰显状态。 罗技接收器会将处于休眠状态的设备从连接中移除，因此它们的最后一个值会保留 30 分钟。
- Keychron 键盘：它们仅通过蓝牙报告电量（通过蓝牙支持显示）。通过 2.4 GHz 接收器时，固件不会显示电量。支持 Keychron 鼠标。
- 其他设备：一些 2.4 GHz 设备使用未公开的协议，目前尚不支持。请参阅 CONTRIBUTING。 md ，了解如何帮助添加一个。

week.desc: Paste a link, get captioned 9:16 clips in ~2 min. Free, local, open-source clipping engine (audio-first, YouTube captions, local LLM).
features: - One-click Make clips, live progress, clips appear one by one with preview and MP4 download.
- Min / Max clip length (e.g. 30–80 s). Clips end on a sentence.

- Facecam position presets (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, bottom-centre, none) for the usual streamer layouts, remembered between sessions. Or draw the face and gameplay boxes yourself in the editor.
- Caption styles: GTA Neon, Impact, Clean, Hormozi and MrBeast. Word-timed, editable words, SRT export.
- Make clips uses your own setup: facecam preset or the boxes you draw in step 03.
- Optical-flow motion + audio highlight ranking, frame-accurate NVENC export (falls back to x264).
- Nothing leaves your computer. The server binds to 127.0.0.1 only.
week.trDesc: 粘贴链接，约 2 分钟即可获得带字幕的 9:16 视频片段。免费、本地、开源的剪辑引擎（音频优先、YouTube 字幕、本地 LLM）。
week.trFeat:
- 一键制作剪辑，实时显示进度，剪辑逐一显示，并提供预览和 MP4 下载。
- 最短/最长片段时长（例如 30–80 秒）。片段以一句话结束。
- 面部摄像头位置预设（左上、右上、左下、右下、下中、无），适用于常见的主播布局，并在各次会话之间记住。或者在编辑器中自行绘制人脸和游戏画面框。 - 字幕样式：GTA Neon、Impact、Clean、Hormozi 和 MrBeast。按字计时、可编辑文字、SRT 导出。
- 使用您自己的设置制作剪辑：面部摄像头预设或您在第 03 步中绘制的方框。
- 光流运动 + 音频高亮排名，帧级精确的 NVENC 导出（回退到 x264）。
- 所有内容都不会离开您的电脑。服务器仅绑定到 127.0.0.1。

week.desc: Mirror of Levent Alpöge's Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis (with Claude). All credit to Levent Alpöge. Source: alpo.ge
features: - RiemannHypothesis is Mathlib's own definition (Mathlib/NumberTheory/LSeries/RiemannZeta.lean, line 185 at the pinned commit), so the headline statement comes from Mathlib, outside this repository:
- src/Statements.lean (16 lines, imports only Mathlib) defines the other four statements:
- RiemannZetaZerosOnLine: every zero of riemannZeta other than the trivial zeros -2(n+1) and s = 1 has real part 1/2
- DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf: for every Dirichlet character χ mod N, LFunction χ s ≠ 0 when Re s 1/2 (excluding χ = 1, s = 1)
- DirichletLZerosOnLine / PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine: zeros of Dirichlet L-functions in the critical strip lie on Re s = 1/2 (GRH for Dirichlet L-functions)
- The proof terms come from src/Supplements/Kernels/MainTheorems.lean:
week.trDesc: Levent Alpöge 对黎曼猜想的精益证明的镜像（与 Claude 一起）。所有功劳归于Levent Alpöge。来源：alpo.ge
week.trFeat:
- RiemannHypothesis 是 Mathlib 自己的定义（Mathlib/NumberTheory/LSeries/RiemannZeta.lean，固定提交的第 185 行），因此标题命题来自 Mathlib，不在本代码仓库中：
- src/Statements.lean（16 行，仅导入 Mathlib）定义了另外四个命题：
- RiemannZetaZerosOnLine ： riemannZeta 的每个零点（平凡零点 -2(n+1) 和 s = 1 除外）的实部为 1/2 - DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf：对于每个狄利克雷（Dirichlet）特征 χ mod N，当 Re s 1/2 时，LFunction χ s ≠ 0（不包括 χ = 1, s = 1）
- DirichletLZerosOnLine / PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine：狄利克雷L函数的零点位于临界带的Re s = 1/2上（狄利克雷L函数的广义黎曼猜想）
- 证明项来自src/Supplements/Kernels/MainTheorems.lean：

week.desc: Agent skill: turn four pixel art views into fake-3D sprites you can spin. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Pi.
features: - --slices N: layer count. 15-20 chunky, 32-48 detailed.
- --order reading: force TOP, SIDE, FRONT, BACK. Default matches views by proportion.
- --round: towers, balloons, pots carve round, not square.
- --side-nose right: the side view faces right.
- --colours N: shared palette size, 0 keeps every colour.
- --normals path.png: save a matching 3D normal-map slice strip.
- --emissive path.png: save an auto-detected emissive mask strip (headlights, windows, neon).
week.trDesc: Agent 技能：将四个像素艺术视图转换为可以旋转的伪 3D 精灵。适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode、Gemini CLI、Pi。
week.trFeat:
- --slices N：层数。15-20 层为粗糙，32-48 层为精细。
- --order reading：强制为顶部、侧面、正面、背面。默认按比例匹配视图。
- --round：塔、气球、罐子雕刻成圆形，而不是方形。
- --side-nose right：侧视图朝右。
- --colours N：共享调色板大小，0 保留每种颜色。
- --normals path.png：保存匹配的 3D 法线贴图切片条带。
- --emissive path. png：保存自动检测的发光遮罩条带（车头灯、车窗、霓虹灯）。
